'''Greenpaw Village''' is located in central [[Ashenvale]], south of [[Raynewood Retreat]], northeast of [[Silverwind Refuge]], and northwest of the southern [[Moonwell (Ashenvale)|moonwell]]. It is the home of the [[Foulweald]] furbolgs, led by [[Chief Murgut]] and the shaman [[Oakpaw]]. Both [[Horde]] and [[Alliance]] adventurers frequently come to Greenpaw to battle the corrupted bearmen.
